parameters.query:
INSERT INTO report_raw_gsc_queries (
  report_date, source_system, source_key,
  payload_json, dimensions_json, metrics_json, batch_id
) VALUES (
  $1::date,
  'gsc',
  $2,
  $3::jsonb,
  $4::jsonb,
  $5::jsonb,
  $6
)
ON CONFLICT (source_system, report_date, source_key) DO UPDATE SET
  payload_json = EXCLUDED.payload_json,
  dimensions_json = EXCLUDED.dimensions_json,
  metrics_json = EXCLUDED.metrics_json,
  batch_id = EXCLUDED.batch_id,
  loaded_at = NOW();

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { ok: true, workflow: 'LT - GSC Daily Ingest', source: 'gsc', reportDate: $node['Config'].json.reportDate } }];
